Help

How to play

Push both contact cables onto the device’s CONTACT PINS. Clip them to two separate points on the same plant. Connect USB with a data cable, then press Start listening.

Keep the plant, cables and device still during calibration.

Check Volume and your speaker output. Press the visual or use the keyboard to try a sound.

MIDI

Use Chrome or Edge with a USB data cable. Allow MIDI and SysEx when the browser asks.
